title: Kenya Safari

gallery.alt: Safari vehicle watching elephants in the Maasai Mara
Giraffes at the Giraffe Centre, Nairobi

overview: A short, big-game safari just a four-hour flight from Lagos. After a night in Nairobi with the Giraffe Centre and the elephant orphanage, you fly to the Maasai Mara for three nights in a tented camp with morning and evening game drives.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Nairobi
itinerary.description: Airport pick-up, afternoon at the Giraffe Centre and the Sheldrick elephant orphanage.
